# A throwaway API and database for the end-to-end tests (Web-UI: npm run test:e2e).
# Nothing here is meant for deployment.
services:
    db:
        image: postgres:17
        environment:
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
            POSTGRES_DB: quicknote
        healthcheck:
            test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d quicknote"]
            interval: 1s
            retries: 30

    api:
        build: ./API
        environment:
            PGHOST: db
            PGPORT: 5432
            PGUSERNAME: postgres
            PGPASSWORD: password
            PGDATABASE: quicknote
            JWT_SECRET: [REDACTED]
        ports:
            - "16943:6943"
        depends_on:
            db:
                condition: service_healthy
        healthcheck:
            test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "fetch('http://localhost:6943/').then(r => process.exit(r.ok ? 0 : 1), () => process.exit(1))"]
            interval: 1s
            retries: 30

// IndexedDB for Dexie
import 'fake-indexeddb/auto'

FROM node:26-bookworm-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev

COPY . .

EXPOSE 6943

# apply pending migrations, then serve
CMD ["sh", "-c", "npx ley up && node app.js"]

{
    "name": "quick-note-web-ui",
    "private": true,
    "engines": {
        "node": ">=26"
    },
    "version": "0.0.0",
    "type": "module",
    "scripts": {
        "test": "vitest run",
        "test:e2e": "vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.js",
        "dev": "vite",
        "build": "vite build",
        "preview": "vite preview"
    },
    "dependencies": {
        "@scure/bip39": "^2.4.0",
        "automerge": "^1.0.1-preview.7",
        "dayjs": "^1.11.23",
        "dexie": "^4.4.6",
        "nanoid": "^6.0.1",
        "node-diff3": "^3.2.1",
        "pinia": "^4.0.3",
        "sql.js": "^1.14.2",
        "vue": "^3.5.43"
    },
    "devDependencies": {
        "@vitejs/plugin-vue": "^6.0.9",
        "fake-indexeddb": "^6.2.5",
        "vite": "^8.3.1",
        "vite-plugin-pwa": "^1.3.0",
        "vitest": "^5.0.2"
    }
}
import 'dotenv/config'
